text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder's chance at victory in<n>the Japan
Cup escapes her. But she<n>wastes no time sulking,
and<n>strengthens her resolve for what will<n>come.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Now more determined than ever, she<n>zeroes in on
the upcoming showdown<n>with Maruzensky at the
Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, El Condor Pasa leaves<n>the venue in a
hurry, almost as if<n>running away from Grass
Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Emotions whirl as the winds grow<n>colder. Winter is
on the horizon, but<n>Grass Wonder's classic year is
far<n>from over yet...
